Application Data.NAME: Acme Assembly Solutions
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Acme Assembly Solutions, 1234 Industrial Parkway, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@acmeassembly.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Assembly Solutions specializes in the assembly and packaging of electronic components and consumer goods. Our operations include the assembly of small electronic devices, as well as the packaging of a variety of products for distribution to retail and wholesale clients. We prioritize safety and have implemented comprehensive training programs for all employees, ensuring they are well-versed in our safety protocols. Our facility operates with scheduled workflows to minimize risk, and we maintain an insured commercial vehicle fleet for distribution purposes. We do not handle or store hazardous materials, thereby aligning with best practices for risk management in our industry.

3.18
Assembly & Packaging Services
Underwriting Appetite
The underwriting appetite for assembly and packaging services is
shaped by the operational complexity, exposure to hazardous materials, and the robustness of
risk management practices. This segment typically involves businesses that assemble components
into finished products or package goods for distribution and sale. These operations can range from
small-scale artisanal packaging to large industrial assembly lines.
• Preferred:
– Contractors and businesses with comprehensive, documented safety training programs
for all employees, including regular refresher courses.
– Operations with scheduled, seasonal workflows that demonstrate minimal claims history,
supported by insured commercial vehicle fleets used for distribution.
